name: Sourcegraph / Cody
tier_reason: Code intelligence leader; defines target for CAP-66..69; closed core makes it a pattern source, not a component
latest_version: UNVERIFIED (no release number on pages read)
license: Proprietary Sourcegraph Enterprise licence for the core (Apache-2.0 until 2023; core moved to private repo Aug 2024; public snapshot archived 2024-09-30); Zoekt Apache-2.0; SCIP and most indexers Apache-2.0
redistribution_notes: No public OEM/embedding right found; offline/air-gapped use requires a vendor-issued licence key; Deep Search requires the Sourcegraph Model Provider (no BYOK).
legal_review_reason: Proprietary core with community-vs-enterprise split (precise nav, Deep Search, Cody are Enterprise); any reuse of pre-2023 Apache-era code needs provenance review.
community_vs_enterprise: Zoekt and SCIP open; precise code navigation, auto-indexing, Deep Search, Cody, Batch Changes enterprise-only. Cody Free/Pro/Starter discontinued 2025-07-23.
resolution_note: Core closed-sourced confirmed (2023 relicence, Aug 2024 private repo). Cody now enterprise-only. Amp spin-off into a separate company reported only by third-party sites (confidence 0.4). Handbook still claims Apache core: stale.
action_reason: User-named leader and competitor benchmark for code intelligence
decision_summary: REJECT embedding; REUSE Zoekt (EXPERIMENT sidecar) and SCIP; BUILD permission-aware code graph; optional INTEGRATE customer Sourcegraph as read-only source

name: Tree-sitter
tier_reason: Parser reuse for BL-42; open syntactic layer under most code-graph tools
latest_version: v0.27.1 (core); py-tree-sitter PyPI info.version read as 0.26.0 (unconfirmed)
release_cadence: roughly monthly in 2026 (0.26.12 Aug 8, 0.26.13 Aug 23, 0.27.0 Aug 30, 0.27.1 Oct 8); pre-1.0 with breaking changes
license: MIT (core and py-tree-sitter); grammar licences per repository UNVERIFIED
redistribution_notes: MIT permits embedding with notice; every shipped grammar must be licence-scanned individually.
legal_review_reason: Core is permissive; trigger only if a shipped grammar is copyleft (not found, not scanned).
resolution_note: Name clean. Distinct from GitHub stack-graphs, which builds on it.
action_reason: Baseline BL-42 dependency; fallback tier below SCIP
decision_summary: REUSE as syntactic/fallback tier and incremental trigger; INTEGRATE with SCIP for precision; REJECT own parser generator

name: SCIP and LSIF
tier_reason: Precise code-index formats; fills the SCIP/LSIF-absent gap in BL-42
owner: Sourcegraph, transitioning to independent open governance with a Core Steering Committee (blog dated 2026-03-25 on a mirror); LSIF: Microsoft
latest_version: UNVERIFIED (no tagged release visible; ProtocolVersion enum has only Unspecified)
release_cadence: continuous on main; governance via SCIP Enhancement Proposals
license: SCIP, scip-java, scip-typescript, scip-go, scip-clang: Apache-2.0; lsif-go: MIT (archived 2023-09-26); scip-python, scip-ruby, scip-dotnet, scip-dart, scip-php, rust-analyzer, debian-lsp: UNVERIFIED on pages read
redistribution_notes: Apache-2.0 allows bundling with notice; unconfirmed indexer licences mean ship ingestor only and let customers install indexers until scanned.
legal_review_reason: scip-python is a fork of Microsoft pyright with licence type not seen; several third-party indexer licences unverified; Apache-2.0 patent clause recorded, no conclusion given.
community_vs_enterprise: Formats and indexers open; the server consuming them at scale (Sourcegraph) is proprietary. LSIF deprecated and removed by Sourcegraph.
resolution_note: Registry entry covers two formats: SCIP (current) and LSIF (deprecated). Repo location changed or mirrored between sourcegraph/* and scip-code/*: unresolved. scip-clang is Beta.
action_reason: User-named; primary route to precise code intelligence
decision_summary: INTEGRATE SCIP via ingestor (BUILD adapter, REUSE proto and indexers); DEFER LSIF; REJECT own indexers
